- **Meta** released its first frontier-class models, **Muse Wonder** and **Muse Wonder Full**, built for personal and professional agents and offered through the Meta Model API and Muse Code.
- **Google** opened **Gemini 4 Argon** to everyone, with introductory API pricing of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output, after a limited launch two weeks earlier.

Sources: [Workday](https://newsroom.workday.com/2026-10-13-Workday-to-Acquire-C1-ai,-a-Leading-Agentic-Identity-Platform-for-People-and-Agents) · [C1.ai](https://www.c1.ai/news/press-release/workday-to-acquire-c1-ai).

Sources: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/13/character-ai-chapter-11-disney-bid.html) · [CBS News](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/character-ai-files-bankruptcy-disney-license/).

The same day, at the OCP Global Summit, Nvidia contributed its Vera Rubin rack and compute-tray designs to the Open Compute Project. Sources: [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/12/microsoft-will-mainly-use-its-maia-chips-for-ai-inference.html) · [SiliconANGLE](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/12/microsoft-debuts-multichiplet-maia-300-inference-accelerator/) · [NVIDIA](https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/ocp-global-summit-vera-rubin-scale-ai-factories/).

## Editorial Notes
- **Primary window:** every body item was first announced inside 2026-10-12T06:07:12Z–2026-10-14T05:01:06Z. Gemini 4 Argon was first unveiled on 2026-09-30; the 2026-10-13 item covers its global rollout and pricing, not a brand-new model.
- **Backfill:** none. No consequential acquisition, merger, funding round, model release or regulatory decision from the 2026-10-05–10-12 recovery window was found missing from the two most recent briefings.
- **Unverified / vendor claims:** Meta, Google, Z.ai, Liquid AI and Fish Audio benchmark, pricing and availability figures are the companies' own unless an independent source is cited. GLM-Legal's "open-weight" description is not confirmed. Prime Intellect's acquisition of vision-model startup Moondream (2026-10-13) and NTT Data's reported final talks to build a 500 MW Anthropic data centre in Osaka (2026-10-13) were verified but trimmed under the three-item cap in Section 6, as were the Cantwell–Rounds letter urging a national AI cyber response (2026-10-13) and a 406-scientist open letter calling for airgapping cyber-capable models.
- **Out of window:** OpenAI's investor disclosure that annualised revenue reached about $50B (2026-10-08), Tencent's reported ~$7B lease of ~100,000 Oracle chips (2026-10-01), Mistral Large 4 (2026-10-06) and Reflection AI's Beam (2026-10-05) fall before the primary window and were not treated as backfill.
- **Data limits:** GitHub star counts and daily deltas are from GitTrend, checked 2026-10-13 UTC, and move quickly; several licenses could not be verified and read "See repo." Paper dates use Hugging Face Daily Papers for 2026-10-13; some were first posted to arXiv earlier.
